_about: R8-RDQ1 (A-117 c) the Token-2022 mint layout and the three extensions that make a dashboard BUY of the mint a no-route refusal. wallet-reads.ts MINT_ACCOUNT_TYPE_OFFSET, MINT_ACCOUNT_TYPE_MINT, MINT_EXT_NON_TRANSFERABLE, MINT_EXT_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_STATE, MINT_EXT_TRANSFER_HOOK and ACCOUNT_STATE_FROZEN equal this file (a test keeps them equal). A sell is never refused by these rules.

layout.tlvEntry: type u16 LE, length u16 LE, value; a type of 0 (Uninitialized) ends the list
layout.note: a mint without extensions is exactly the 82 byte base mint; a mint with extensions is padded to the size of a base token account (165 bytes), then the account-type byte, then the TLV entries

extensions.name: DefaultAccountState
extensions.refusedWhen: the state byte is 2 (Frozen): every new token account of the mint starts frozen

extensions.name: NonTransferable
extensions.refusedWhen: present: the tokens can never be moved

extensions.name: TransferHook
extensions.refusedWhen: the program id (bytes 32 to 63 of the value; the first 32 are the authority) is not all zero: a program runs on every transfer

status: NOT FETCHED: this build had no network access. The numbers 6, 9 and 14, the account-type offset 165 and the Frozen state value 2 are the ones named by amendment A-117 (c); the value sizes are the spl-token-2022 pod layouts as the author recalls them. Any extension type not listed here does not refuse a buy. Before go-live the owner re-checks each entry against the spl-token-2022 ExtensionType list.
